post.description: Invalidates the Sweden weather cache by bumping the internal cache version used in weather request cache keys.

get.description: Resolves coordinates from the Sweden player dataset (or latlon) and returns OpenWeather data.

parameters.name: latlon
parameters.description: The raw comma-separated coordinates (e.g., 32.46564,12.8737874). Optional when player is provided.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: A Broadsign player ID resolved from the Sweden player dataset. Optional when latlon is provided.

parameters.name: com.broadsign.suite.bsp.resource_id
parameters.description: An alias of player that resolves the same Broadsign player ID from the Sweden dataset.

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Optional debug flag. When set to true, the response includes a debug object with the original upstream OpenWeather URL, with the appid value masked.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional response format. By default returns JavaScript as data = {...};. Use format=json to return raw JSON.

post.description: Invalidates the Norway flights cache by bumping the internal cache version used in flights request cache keys.

get.description: Returns Avinor flight data for a gate at a Norwegian airport (default OSL). Provide either `gate` or `player` (mutually exclusive). Default direction is departures (D). Player records supply Gate and IATA.

parameters.name: gate
parameters.description: Airport gate to filter flights (e.g. A4). Mutually exclusive with player.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: A Broadsign player ID resolved to Gate and IATA from the Norway player dataset. Mutually exclusive with gate.

parameters.name: com.broadsign.suite.bsp.resource_id
parameters.description: An alias of player that resolves the same Broadsign player ID. Mutually exclusive with gate.

parameters.name: iata
parameters.description: IATA airport code override (e.g. OSL, BGO). Defaults to OSL when omitted and the player has no IATA configured. Alias: airport.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Flight direction. A = arrivals, D = departures. Defaults to D.

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Optional debug flag. When set to true, the response includes a debug object with the upstream Avinor URL and related metadata.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Optional response format. By default returns JavaScript as data = {...};. Use format=json to return raw JSON.
